name: @lune/desktop
description: Lune Shell - the Electron/React front-end (window/overlay, capture, playback, UI).
//deps: Only the deps externalized from the main/preload bundles (native addons + zod, which the bundled @lune/shared/@lune/core require at runtime) ship in node_modules. Everything else - the two workspace packages and the renderer libs (react, framer-motion, ...) - is bundled into out/ by electron-vite, so it is a build-time (dev) dependency as far as packaging is concerned. This keeps the installer lean (ticket 15 acceptance #3) and keeps electron-builder from trying to pack the pnpm workspace symlinks.
